style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: big COBALT-BLUE vest, round glasses, red party cone. Calm, serious. His wings hold ONE white cake with lit wax numbers 6 and 5.
second_characters: ONE mole boss, grey suit, ORANGE party cone, clean long claws. ONE beaver colleague, white moustache, GREEN party cone. Both throw the goose.
props: Cake 6-5: goose's. Cake 6-4 on the buffet table by the wall, nobody's until 9.2 s. Napkin: mole's, 5.6-7.0 s. Wax 5: mole's paw at 9.2 s.
environment: Office farewell party: honey parquet floor, TURQUOISE walls, pink-and-gold flag garland under the ceiling, one gold balloon 6, buffet table by the wall.
lighting: Warm key on the goose's face, orange rim left, violet rim right. Blue vest and red cone vivid in every shot, close-ups too.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice 0.6-7.0 s, beak free while speaking; no speech after 7.0 s

timeline.a: From the first frame: goose hangs upside down in the garland, cake level; flags tear, he drops feet first knee-deep into the parquet, boards fly up in a fan.
timeline.c: hurls itself down with the falling goose

timeline.a: Goose fixes his glasses, beak free, raises his wings; mole and beaver grab him under the wings and yank him out; cake 6-4 on the buffet table behind.
timeline.c: dives low under the paws, paws in foreground

timeline.a: Goose flies up and somersaults by the garland, beak free, neck keeps the cake level, wings flick open and fold back; he drops waist-deep into the parquet.
timeline.c: flies up with him in a somersault

timeline.a: Colleagues yank him out, swing him twice and hurl him higher; goose hits the gold balloon 6, beak free.
Goose spins down like a drill, cake on the axis, beak free, and screws neck-deep into the parquet; sawdust fountains up onto the cake, wax 6 and 5 still lit.
timeline.c: dives in a spiral into the cake, close-up

timeline.a: Goose's head at floor level, beak free, wings raise the cake over his head; mole squats and wipes his clean claws with the napkin; beaver stamps the boards down round the goose.
timeline.c: hurls itself at the beak, close-up, then skims over the boards to the mole's claws

timeline.a: Mole and beaver run in and jump together, both feet onto the goose's red cone; goose goes into the floor whole, only the cake sticks up in his wings.
timeline.c: hurls itself onto the red cone, close-up

timeline.a: Wings sink, cake shoots up, flips once and lands on the hole wax side up; mole hammers the boards flat with his heel.
timeline.c: rockets back up, cake in foreground

timeline.a: First, clearly: at the buffet table mole pulls wax 4 out of cake 6-4 and pushes in wax 5, now 6-5. Then he tosses the frozen beaver up. Last frame: beaver upside down in the garland.
timeline.c: whips round to cake 6-4, close-up, flies up
